title: VANILLA+lite
description: A lightweight Vanilla+ Minecraft modpack designed for smooth performance on low-end PCs and laptops.
body:
Vanilla+ Lite is a lightweight Minecraft modpack that keeps the original Minecraft experience while improving performance and adding small quality-of-life features.

Perfect for:
• Low-end PCs
• Laptops
• Players who want smooth vanilla gameplay

Features:
• Massive FPS improvements
• Vanilla-friendly gameplay
• Helpful UI improvements
• Optional shaders support
• Lightweight and stable

Recommended RAM: 3–4GB
